input.quote: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
input.rationale: Section 15 is the only assignment provision and no change-of-control language appears elsewhere in the Agreement. It bars assignment without the other party's prior written approval with only an affiliate carve-out: there is no M&A/successor carve-out for Client, and consent is not qualified by a reasonableness standard. That fails the fallback (mutual right to assign to successors with notice; other consents not unreasonably withheld) and approaches walk-away territory (prohibition on Customer assignment with no M&A carve-out), since a merger or sale of substantially all assets would require TrueLink's discretionary approval. The redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out for Client, imposes a not-unreasonably-withheld standard plus a no-competitor limit on TrueLink assignments, and confirms a Client change of control triggers no TrueLink termination or re-pricing right.

proposal.summary: Add Client affiliate/successor assignment carve-out and a reasonableness standard on Vendor assignment consent.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added the customary carve-out allowing us to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and made consent to any other assignment subject to a reasonableness standard, with TrueLink not assigning to a competitor of ours. Our playbook requires an M&A/successor carve-out; if helpful, we can instead accept a mutual right to assign to successors on written notice.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Client may assign or transfer this Agreement and its rights hereunder, without the prior written approval of TrueLink, to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in interest by way of merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or of the business to which this Agreement relates. TrueLink shall not assign or transfer any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written approval of Client, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of Client. Any other assignment or transfer shall require the prior written approval of the other party, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld. No change of control of Client shall constitute an assignment or give rise to any right of TrueLink to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.
